endpoints.description: Returns the model-backed operation catalog (which ops need an input image, which need a mask, which are prompt-driven) plus each op's seeded default model.

Submits one AI generation/enhancement op on optionally-uploaded image(s). The `file` part carries the input image (when required), `mask` carries a mask (inpaint/object_removal), and `params` carries AIParams as protojson. The op runs asynchronously on the durable job queue: the response (SubmitAIResponse) carries the job id + ETA + the resolved model/tier + any fallback warnings. Wait via the jobs verbs and fetch the output blob by the job's result ref.

errors.description: Malformed multipart form, missing required image/mask part, or invalid params
Unknown AI operation
Selected model is not installed (run `image-tools models install <id>`)
Image exceeds the ingest byte limit
No enabled model fits this host, or the model override is invalid
No standalone backend is available and BYOK is not enabled

rest_exception.note: Image/mask bytes cannot ride a proto field; the request is multipart (file + mask + protojson params). Parameters stay proto-typed (AIParams) and the submit result is proto-typed (SubmitAIResponse).
